name: Warlord Gorchuk
summary: Warlord Gorchuk is an orc commander stationed in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits. Tasked with organizing the Horde's side of the massive Ahn'Qiraj War Effort, he tracks logistical stockpiles and directs vital supplies south to Silithus.

sections.title: Marshal of the Horde War Effort
sections.body: When ancient terrors began stirring beneath the shifting sands of Silithus, the Horde recognized a threat capable of sweeping across Kalimdor and consuming all life. To meet the swarms of Ahn'Qiraj, the Horde required an unprecedented mobilization of metals, herbs, leathers, bandages, and provisions. Warlord Gorchuk serves as the logistical head of this operation within Orgrimmar. Stationed in the Valley of Spirits, he tallies incoming materials from adventurers and craftsmen across the realm, ensuring supply lines are filled before the grand march southward begins.

sections.title: An Uneasy Truce Against the Old God
sections.body: Though proud of the Horde's martial strength, Gorchuk openly acknowledges the chilling scope of the looming conflict. The insectoid qiraji and their master, the Old God C'Thun, despise all mortal life forged by the ancient Titans. Because neither faction can endure such an onslaught alone, Gorchuk coordinates closely with intelligence regarding the Alliance's own mobilization, tracking collective stockpiles until both factions are prepared to ship their full arsenal to the Scarab Dais.

faq.q: Where can I find Warlord Gorchuk?
faq.answer: Warlord Gorchuk is stationed in the Valley of Spirits within the Horde capital of Orgrimmar, coordinating resource collection for the impending campaign in Silithus.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the war supplies Gorchuk requests?
faq.answer: The gathered materials—spanning hundreds of thousands of bandages, metal bars, leathers, cooked meals, and herbs—are stockpiled to equip and sustain the united armies preparing to confront the qiraji armies sealed behind the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.

faq.q: Why is the Horde working alongside the Alliance for this campaign?
faq.answer: As Gorchuk explains, the threat posed by C'Thun and the qiraji threatens to destroy all mortal life across Kalimdor. Facing an entity that despises all creatures born of the Titans, both factions have agreed to a collective war effort to ensure mutual survival.

faq.q: How can players check the progress of the War Effort?
faq.answer: Speaking directly with Warlord Gorchuk provides up-to-date accounting on every required material, detailing exactly how many bars, herbs, bandages, skins, and fish the Horde has amassed toward its final goal.

angles.text: Warlord Gorchuk embodies the Horde's collective resolve, rallying orcs, trolls, tauren, and Forsaken to pool their labor and defend Kalimdor from total annihilation.
